name: SuperGLEBer
description: SuperGLEBer is a comprehensive Natural Language Understanding benchmark suite for the German language, covering 29 tasks including document classification, sequence tagging, sentence similarity, and question answering to evaluate German-capable language models.
reputation: A respected German NLU benchmark suite that is commonly used to evaluate German-language models across many tasks.
notes: Includes a public leaderboard and encourages community contributions.
